name: ACTRA (HLI, 2025)
summary: Group cognitive behavioural therapy for young men at risk of violence and crime in Colombia. The Happier Lives Institute's predictive estimate (WELLBYs per $1,000), rebuilt from the figures in its report, which adapts its model of NEPI's programme in Liberia.

source.title: The promise of ACTRA: preventing crime with cognitive behavioural therapy
source.license: © Happier Lives Institute; no licence published. Numbers cited as facts with their source.

resources.title: HLI, The promise of ACTRA (2025)
resources.note: HLI publishes no public spreadsheet for this estimate: the model is built from the inputs and figures stated in the report's text, each quoted on its row.

resources.title: HLI, Stealing happiness? The wellbeing cost-effectiveness of NEPI (2024)
resources.note: The model HLI adapts for ACTRA.

sections.title: Benefits per participant (HLI's NEPI model, therapy-only arm)
sections.explainer: HLI's NEPI model, rerun for the therapy-only arm of the Liberian trial (Blattman et al. 2017; 10-year follow-up 2023) with Colombian household sizes.

sections.title: Discounting
sections.explainer: charityevals' step, not HLI's. HLI counts a year of better wellbeing the same whenever it comes. In our view, later years count less at the discount rate under Your values, as in GiveWell's models; the evaluator view sets the rate to 0, so HLI's figure is unchanged there.

sections.title: Staff pay below market
sections.explainer: charityevals' step, not the evaluator's: with credit by share of resources on, staff's pay below what they could earn elsewhere counts as an in-kind contribution and gets its share of the outcome. Off by default.

rows.label: WELLBYs for the participant and his household

source.title: HLI report
source.quote: The recipient and household effects decrease from 3 → 1.04 WELLBYs

rows.explainer: Smaller than in HLI's NEPI estimate because therapy alone had a smaller effect on the men's wellbeing in the trial (0.08 SDs, against 0.19 for therapy plus cash) and Colombian households are smaller (1.66 other members, against 2.74).

rows.label: WELLBYs for people spared from crime

source.title: HLI report
source.quote: The benefit to victims increased from 10.7 → 11.1 WELLBYs

rows.explainer: Fewer thefts and the wellbeing of the would-be victims: therapy alone cut thefts slightly more in the trial (350 over 10 years, against 338).

rows.label: Total WELLBYs per participant
rows.explainer: HLI: "The total benefit thus decreases from 13.6 → 12.1 WELLBYS".

rows.label: Cost per participant

source.title: HLI report
source.quote: which means the naive cost of therapy is $330

rows.explainer: NEPI's $630 per participant less its $300 cash transfer. HLI thinks the cost could fall well below this, as other charities deliver therapy for under $50, but also that costs in Latin America may run higher.

rows.label: WELLBYs per $1,000
rows.explainer: HLI: "Putting all of these into our existing model nearly doubles the cost-effectiveness from 22 → 37 WELLBYs created per $1,000 donated." A prediction for a programme still in its pilot.

rows.label: Discount rate on future wellbeing
rows.explainer: The shared discount rate (Your values). HLI doesn't discount, so the evaluator view pins it at 0.

rows.label: Years the benefits are spread over
rows.explainer: HLI counts benefits over the trial's 10-year follow-up; we spread them evenly over those years.

rows.label: Discount factor for benefits spread evenly over those years
rows.explainer: The present value of an equal benefit each year over the years above, starting now, as a share of the undiscounted total: 1 at a 0% rate, lower the longer the benefit lasts.

rows.label: Staff pay as a share of program cost
rows.explainer: Default for programs where staff deliver the help themselves (treatment, counselling, coaching, outreach): staff pay is about half the cost. Our judgment; we haven't seen this program's breakdown.

rows.label: Pay gap versus comparable jobs elsewhere
rows.explainer: Health workers and field staff at nonprofits often earn somewhat less than in comparable jobs. Our judgment.

rows.label: Salary forgone by staff per dollar of cost (in-kind donation)
Share of the full cost paid in cash
rows.explainer: With credit by share of resources, staff's forgone pay counts as part of the cost, and staff get their share of the outcome. Off, this is 100%.

rows.label: WELLBYs per dollar
rows.explainer: The figure per dollar above; with credit by share of resources, times the share of the full cost paid in cash (staff's forgone pay is the rest).
